# SAVO

> Free New Zealand app that helps drivers document car accidents, lodge insurance claims, request courtesy cars, and find trusted panel beaters and tow companies.

SAVO guides Kiwi drivers through exactly what insurers (IAG, AA, Tower, State, AMI, Vero) need after a crash — photos, GPS, third-party details, witnesses, and a signed PDF report ready to email.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of SAVO's free accident and claims tools for NZ drivers.
- [How It Works](/how-it-works): Step-by-step guide to documenting an accident and lodging a claim with SAVO.
- [About](/about): Founder story, mission, and contact details.
- [FAQ](/faq): Answers to common questions about claims, panel shops, and using SAVO.
- [Panel Beaters](/panel-shops): Directory of trusted NZ repair shops with locations and contact details.
- [Tow Companies](/tow-companies): Directory of NZ tow operators sorted by proximity.
- [Fault Guide](/fault-guide): Plain-English guide to who is at fault in common NZ accident scenarios.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on NZ car insurance, claims, courtesy cars, and road safety.
- [Legal](/legal): Terms of service.
- [Privacy](/privacy): Privacy policy.
